branches.expected: A successful source stream starts once, yields a reconstructable terminal response, and completes exactly once.
All source content block types and fragmented tool inputs normalize to ordered events and replayable terminal blocks.
Provider counters normalize without double counting cache or reasoning tokens and preserve provider totals.
Every rate-priced protocol preserves exact input, output, cache-read, cache-write, and total monetary cost.
Every calculateCost protocol selects the highest applicable full-request input threshold.
Anthropic 1h cache writes use twice the selected base input rate while 5m writes use cache-write pricing.
Pi Messages preserves the five monetary values supplied by the upstream event without recalculation.
Standard and Codex Responses apply exact flex and priority multipliers with source request/response precedence.
Azure Responses preserves base model pricing because pinned source does not install service-tier adjustment.
Every successful terminal source reason maps explicitly to stop, length, or tool use for every applicable protocol.
Anthropic redaction, signatures, pause semantics, and extended usage remain replayable.
Bedrock reasoning content and metadata usage preserve all source fields.
Pi-native opaque replay metadata is preserved in its exact content block.
Google thought signatures attach to the correct text, reasoning, or tool block and usage excludes cached input.
Mistral content unions, reasoning blocks, tool fragments, null IDs, and cache usage normalize deterministically.
Image responses preserve supported data URLs, text, empty output, and usage while deterministically skipping unsupported URLs.
OpenAI-compatible completion extensions and compatibility branches are independently source-derived.
Responses API item variants, replay signatures, terminal status details, and service-tier usage are independently source-derived for standard, Azure, and Codex.
